path.description: CFS canonical absolute path to the text file to edit.

old_string.description: Exact non-empty text to replace. It must match file content exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true.

new_string.description: Replacement text. It must differ from old_string and may be empty to delete the matched text.

expected_revision.description: Expected current revision (>0) of the file to edit.

replace_all.description: Replace every exact occurrence of old_string. Defaults to false.
